programs.program_name: New Zealand Screen Production Rebate — International (NZSPR-Int)
programs.rate_details: 20% baseline cash rebate on Qualifying New Zealand Production Expenditure (QNZPE). An additional 5% Uplift may be granted, at the discretion of the Minister responsible, where a production demonstrates significant economic and industry benefits to New Zealand under the published Uplift criteria. Maximum effective rate with Uplift is 25%.
programs.minimum_spend_notes: Minimum QNZPE thresholds: NZD 15M for feature films; for TV and other formats the threshold is set on a per-hour or per-project basis — verify the current published threshold against the NZFC scheme rules for the specific format. The value stored here (15M NZD) is the feature-film threshold.
programs.atl_cap_notes: Wages and fees for services performed in New Zealand qualify regardless of the individual's residency, but non-resident ATL talent (e.g., non-NZ cast and director fees) is subject to caps under the scheme rules — verify current per-individual caps and the aggregate non-resident ATL cap against the published QNZPE manual before relying on ATL numbers for budgeting.
programs.qualifying_spend_summary: QNZPE: expenditure on goods and services for the production that are provided in New Zealand, including New Zealand labour and services performed in New Zealand by non-residents, and a defined set of post-production / VFX / digital expenditures.
programs.non_qualifying_spend: Expenditure on goods or services not provided in New Zealand; financing costs; marketing and distribution; deferments; expenditure outside the production's eligible window.
programs.application_process: 1) Provisional application to the New Zealand Film Commission (NZFC) before principal photography to confirm eligibility. 2) Final application after delivery, supported by an audited Statement of QNZPE prepared by an approved auditor. 3) Uplift, if sought, requires a separate application demonstrating significant economic benefits, assessed by an Uplift Panel and decided by the responsible Minister.
programs.payment_timing: Cash rebate paid after the NZFC accepts the final application and audited QNZPE statement. Typical timeline is several months from final submission; verify current processing time with NZFC.
programs.notes: SEED ENTRY — compiled from program knowledge during initial database build; live re-verification against nzfilm.co.nz scheme rules is required before any production budgeting use. Key fields to verify on re-check: (a) current baseline rate (the scheme has been subject to review and rate adjustments); (b) current Uplift criteria and percentage; (c) exact per-format minimum QNZPE thresholds; (d) any per-applicant annual aggregate cap; (e) current non-resident ATL caps. There is a separate NZSPR-Domestic (Premium) scheme for productions with significant NZ creative content — out of scope for this entry, add as a separate program.
